questions.unit_reason: One emission-versus-reflection classification across a mixed set preserves the request for several examples, rather than splitting every object into a yes/no item.

stem.zh: 下列物体中，哪些在所述状态下自身发出可见光？
stem.en: Which objects emit visible light themselves in the stated conditions?

text.zh: 受到太阳照射的月球表面
text.en: The Moon's surface illuminated by the Sun

options.derivation: Moonlight in these conditions is reflected incident sunlight, not visible emission by the lunar surface.
options.misconception: Observe that the illuminated Moon looks bright, then equate visible brightness with production of its own visible light.

text.zh: 正在正常发光的LED灯
text.en: An LED lamp operating normally and glowing

options.derivation: The powered LED converts electrical energy into emitted visible photons; its light is not merely an image of an external illuminator.

text.zh: 映出灯光的普通镜子
text.en: An ordinary mirror reflecting a lamp

options.derivation: The mirror redirects light emitted by the lamp; the stated mirror is not an independent visible emitter.
options.misconception: Assign the light seen in a reflected image to the mirror instead of following its origin back to the lamp.

text.zh: 正在燃烧的蜡烛火焰
text.en: The flame of a burning candle

options.derivation: A burning candle flame emits visible radiation through its hot luminous material and combustion processes, rather than merely reflecting an external illuminator.

text.zh: 不发荧光、在日光下显得明亮的普通白纸
text.en: Ordinary nonfluorescent white paper appearing bright in daylight

options.derivation: The explicitly nonfluorescent ordinary paper is bright by scattering incident daylight; ultraviolet-to-visible fluorescence is excluded by the stated material condition.
options.misconception: Treat strong diffuse reflection from a white surface as the same process as emission from a powered or hot source.

questions.unit_reason: Classify the complete spectral distribution, including the meaning of continuous, in one coherent response.

stem.zh: 普通白炽灯的炽热固体灯丝产生的可见光谱，应怎样描述？
stem.en: How should the visible spectrum emitted by the hot solid filament of an ordinary incandescent lamp be described?

text.zh: 由彼此分离的谱线组成，各线之间没有辐射。
text.en: Separated lines, with no radiation between the lines.

options.derivation: A hot solid filament gives a broad thermal spectrum, not the isolated-line pattern of an excited low-density atomic gas.
options.misconception: Transfer the isolated atomic transition picture of a dilute gas unchanged to thermal emission from a hot solid.

text.zh: 只有一个波长，因为整个灯丝大致处于同一温度。
text.en: Only one wavelength, because the filament is approximately at one temperature.

options.derivation: One temperature determines a broad thermal distribution, not a monochromatic wavelength.
options.misconception: Replace a spectrum with its characteristic temperature-dependent peak and treat that peak as the only emitted wavelength.

text.zh: 覆盖连续波长范围，但强度可以随波长改变。
text.en: A continuous range of wavelengths, with intensity varying by wavelength.

options.derivation: Thermal emission from the solid filament spans a continuous range; continuity says nothing about a flat intensity distribution.

text.zh: 覆盖连续波长范围，且各可见波长的强度相同。
text.en: A continuous range of wavelengths, with the same intensity at every visible wavelength.

options.derivation: The spectrum is continuous but not uniform in intensity; a thermal distribution has wavelength-dependent intensity.
options.misconception: Read continuous as constant, replacing absence of wavelength gaps with equal intensity at every wavelength.

questions.unit_reason: Recognize one complete optical arrangement, retaining slit placement, collimation, diffraction and focused observation as linked tasks.

stem.zh: 用普通薄透镜把棱镜光谱仪改成衍射光栅光谱仪。以下哪种布置能在探测面观察清晰、分开的各波长狭缝像？
stem.en: A prism spectrometer is changed to a diffraction-grating spectrometer using ordinary thin lenses. Which arrangement forms focused, separated wavelength images of the slit at the detector?

text.zh: 狭缝放在准直透镜前两倍焦距处；光栅置于其后，在望远镜物镜后一个焦距处记录非零级。
text.en: The slit is twice the focal length in front of the collimator; the grating follows it, and a nonzero order is recorded one focal length behind the telescope objective.

options.derivation: A slit at twice the collimator focal length forms a finite-distance image rather than parallel output. The telescope's back focal plane is the image plane for parallel beams, not for this finite-distance conjugate; it does not provide the required focused slit images in this stated arrangement.
options.misconception: Treat any passage through a lens as collimation, ignoring the required object-to-focal-plane relationship.

text.zh: 狭缝放在准直透镜前一个焦距处；光栅置于其后，在望远镜物镜后一个焦距处记录非零级。
text.en: The slit is one focal length in front of the collimator; the grating follows it, and a nonzero order is recorded one focal length behind the telescope objective.

options.derivation: A focal-plane slit is collimated, a nonzero grating order separates wavelengths by angle, and the telescope produces focused slit images.

text.zh: 狭缝放在准直透镜前一个焦距处；光栅置于其后，在望远镜物镜后一个焦距处只记录零级。
text.en: The slit is one focal length in front of the collimator; the grating follows it, and only the zero order is recorded one focal length behind the telescope objective.

options.derivation: The zero-order beam does not separate the wavelengths into the required spectrum.
options.misconception: Select the brightest undeviated grating image and assume every grating order has wavelength-dependent angular separation.

text.zh: 狭缝放在准直透镜前一个焦距处；光栅置于其后，在望远镜物镜平面记录非零级。
text.en: The slit is one focal length in front of the collimator; the grating follows it, and a nonzero order is recorded at the telescope objective plane.

options.derivation: The telescope objective plane is not the plane of focused wavelength-separated slit images.
options.misconception: Place the detector where light enters the objective instead of where the imaging optics bring each angular beam to focus.

questions.unit_reason: Recognize a complete sample-preparation principle that supplies the required atomic emission, rather than a single processing verb.

stem.zh: 为测量一小粒样品的原子发射谱线，哪种处理原则能够提供所需的光？
stem.en: Which preparation principle can supply light for measuring the atomic emission lines of a small sample?

text.zh: 用适当装置使样品原子化并受到激发，收集离开样品的光进行分光。
text.en: Use suitable equipment to atomize and excite the sample, then collect light leaving the sample for dispersion.

options.derivation: Atomization and excitation provide emitting atoms; their characteristic transition wavelengths can be compared with reference lines.

text.zh: 只把样品磨成细粉并照以白光，收集离开样品的光进行分光。
text.en: Only grind the sample into powder and illuminate it with white light, then collect the outgoing light for dispersion.

options.derivation: Grinding and passive white-light reflection do not alone excite atoms to produce the specified characteristic emission.
options.misconception: Substitute the sample's visible reflected color for the wavelengths of light generated by excited atoms.

text.zh: 只将样品溶入透明液体并照以白光，收集穿过样品的光进行分光。
text.en: Only dissolve the sample in a transparent liquid and illuminate it with white light, then collect the transmitted light for dispersion.

options.derivation: Transmission or absorption of an external beam is not the requested atomic emission produced by sample excitation.
options.misconception: Replace emission spectroscopy with a transmission arrangement while continuing to attribute the illuminator's photons to sample emission.

text.zh: 只把样品冷却并抛光，然后照以白光，收集离开样品的光进行分光。
text.en: Only cool and polish the sample, then illuminate it with white light and collect the outgoing light for dispersion.

options.derivation: Cooling and polishing may alter thermal or reflected radiation but do not supply the needed atomic excitation.
options.misconception: Confuse improved reflection from a polished surface with the creation of characteristic atomic radiation.

questions.unit_reason: Select one coherent wavelength-dependent transmission explanation that also answers why attenuation is not total ultraviolet blocking.

stem.zh: 普通玻璃窗透过太阳光时，哪种紫外线透过情况及结论较符合实际？
stem.en: Which ultraviolet transmission pattern and conclusion best describe ordinary window glass in sunlight?

text.zh: UVA和UVB都被完全挡住；能透过可见光就说明窗内没有紫外线。
text.en: Both UVA and UVB are completely blocked; visible transmission means no ultraviolet remains indoors.

options.derivation: Ordinary glass can transmit substantial UVA, so complete ultraviolet removal does not follow from its visible transparency.
options.misconception: Turn strong absorption in one ultraviolet band into a universal claim of zero transmission in every ultraviolet band.

text.zh: UVB较易透过而UVA被大量吸收；剩余紫外线主要是UVB。
text.en: UVB passes more readily while UVA is strongly absorbed; the remaining ultraviolet is mainly UVB.

options.derivation: The ordinary-glass comparison is reversed: most UVB is filtered while substantial longer-wavelength UVA can pass.
options.misconception: Reverse the relative transmission of the shorter UVB and longer UVA bands.

text.zh: UVA和UVB都基本不变；可见光透明意味着紫外线也同样透明。
text.en: Both UVA and UVB are largely unchanged; visible transparency implies the same ultraviolet transparency.

options.derivation: Visible transparency does not imply wavelength-independent transmission; ordinary glass removes much of the UVB.
options.misconception: Extrapolate a material's visible-light transparency to all electromagnetic wavelengths without testing its spectral response.

text.zh: 大部分UVB被吸收，仍有相当一部分UVA透过；吸收具有波长选择性。
text.en: Most UVB is absorbed while substantial UVA still passes; absorption is wavelength dependent.

options.derivation: Selective attenuation leaves transmitted UVA and therefore is not equivalent to complete blocking of ultraviolet sunlight.

questions.unit_reason: Choose a complete formation mechanism and the layer it probes, preserving the atmosphere-versus-deep-interior contrast.

stem.zh: 由太阳自身物质形成的吸收线，主要怎样产生，又主要反映哪一部分的成分？
stem.en: How do absorption lines formed by the Sun's own material mainly arise, and which region's composition do they mainly indicate?

text.zh: 深层核心直接吸收即将离开太阳的光；暗线直接给出核心的完整成分。
text.en: The deep core directly absorbs light just before it leaves the Sun; the lines directly give the core's complete composition.

options.derivation: The escaping spectrum's line-forming regions are atmospheric; the observed absorption lines do not directly inventory the deep core.
options.misconception: Follow the ultimate energy source inward and identify it with the region performing the final wavelength-selective absorption.

text.zh: 核心发出黑色的离散谱线而没有连续背景；暗线反映太阳核心。
text.en: The core emits discrete black lines with no continuous background; the dark lines indicate the solar core.

options.derivation: An absorption line is reduced intensity relative to a background, not an emitted black photon or black emission line.
options.misconception: Apply the idea of bright emission lines to dark absorption features and treat darkness as a kind of emitted radiation.

text.zh: 较冷的太阳大气选择性吸收光球的连续背景；暗线主要反映形成谱线的大气层。
text.en: Cooler solar atmospheric regions selectively absorb the photospheric continuum; the lines mainly indicate the line-forming atmosphere.

options.derivation: Atmospheric atoms and ions remove selected wavelengths from the photospheric background; the wavelengths identify the line-forming material.

text.zh: 太阳大气在某些波长增加发射，使这些波长变暗；暗线主要反映太阳大气。
text.en: Solar atmospheric emission adds light at selected wavelengths and makes those wavelengths darker; the lines mainly indicate the atmosphere.

options.derivation: Adding emission alone increases intensity at those wavelengths; it is selective absorption relative to the continuum that accounts for the stated dark features.
options.misconception: Recognize the correct layer but exchange absorption and emission while retaining the observed decrease in brightness.

questions.unit_reason: Recognize an entire coherent three-band detector mapping, not independent answer-box clicks or pair-combination codes.

stem.zh: 为分别记录无线电波、可见光和伦琴射线，哪一组常规装置与波段的配对合适？
stem.en: Which set of conventional band-to-device matches is suitable for recording radio waves, visible light, and X-rays?

text.zh:
| 波段 | 装置 |
| --- | --- |
| 无线电波 | 普通可见光相机的硅传感器 |
| 可见光 | 常规AM广播天线与接收电路 |
| 伦琴射线 | X射线闪烁体与光电读出装置 |
text.en:
| Band | Device |
| --- | --- |
| Radio waves | Silicon sensor of an ordinary visible-light camera |
| Visible light | Conventional AM radio antenna and receiver |
| X-rays | X-ray scintillator with optical readout |

options.derivation: The radio and visible detectors are exchanged: an ordinary camera is not an AM-field receiver, and an ordinary AM receiver is not an optical detector.
options.misconception: Assume shared electromagnetic identity makes an ordinary radio antenna and an ordinary optical semiconductor camera interchangeable.

text.zh:
| 波段 | 装置 |
| --- | --- |
| 无线电波 | 常规AM广播天线与接收电路 |
| 可见光 | 普通可见光相机的硅传感器 |
| 伦琴射线 | X射线闪烁体与光电读出装置 |
text.en:
| Band | Device |
| --- | --- |
| Radio waves | Conventional AM radio antenna and receiver |
| Visible light | Silicon sensor of an ordinary visible-light camera |
| X-rays | X-ray scintillator with optical readout |

options.derivation: Radio reception uses antenna-induced electrical signals, visible photons create camera signals, and an X-ray scintillator converts absorbed X-ray energy into light for optical readout.

text.zh:
| 波段 | 装置 |
| --- | --- |
| 无线电波 | 常规AM广播天线与接收电路 |
| 可见光 | 普通可见光相机的硅传感器 |
| 伦琴射线 | 常规AM广播天线与接收电路 |
text.en:
| Band | Device |
| --- | --- |
| Radio waves | Conventional AM radio antenna and receiver |
| Visible light | Silicon sensor of an ordinary visible-light camera |
| X-rays | Conventional AM radio antenna and receiver |

options.derivation: An ordinary AM antenna and receiver are not configured to convert X-ray energy into a recorded signal.
options.misconception: Extend successful radio-wave electrical reception to the X-ray band without changing the detector's scale or interaction mechanism.

text.zh:
| 波段 | 装置 |
| --- | --- |
| 无线电波 | 普通可见光摄影胶片 |
| 可见光 | 普通可见光相机的硅传感器 |
| 伦琴射线 | X射线闪烁体与光电读出装置 |
text.en:
| Band | Device |
| --- | --- |
| Radio waves | Ordinary visible-light photographic film |
| Visible light | Silicon sensor of an ordinary visible-light camera |
| X-rays | X-ray scintillator with optical readout |

options.derivation: Ordinary photographic film does not record conventional radio waves as it records sufficiently energetic optical photons.
options.misconception: Transfer photography's response to visible radiation to radio waves while ignoring the very different per-photon energies and detection mechanism.

coverage_notes.2: Original spectrum classification is retained, with an explicit continuous-versus-flat distinction.
coverage_notes.3: No source figure or spacing was supplied. The visible requirement specifies the conventional parallel-incidence, focused-image arrangement; drawing and alignment are not demonstrated.
coverage_notes.4: The visible task remains atomic emission spectroscopy. No universal treatment temperature or practical experiment instruction is imposed.
coverage_notes.5: The scientifically corrected written task, not the source's false no-tanning premise, is the seed. Ordinary glazing is not a universal protection specification.
coverage_notes.6: The visible Sun's-own-material condition excludes telluric absorption without claiming that every solar line forms in one sharply bounded layer.
coverage_notes.7: AM radio specifies an ordinary radio example rather than every possible radio frequency. The full triple is a detector-matching example, not an exhaustive inventory.
